items.stem: What is the key mindset shift when moving from individual contributor to manager?

options.text: Success is measured through the team's outcomes, not only your own output
options.rationale: Correct: a manager delivers through others, so team results become the measure of success.

options.text: You should personally do the hardest tasks yourself
options.rationale: That undermines delegation and the team's growth.

options.text: Your individual output matters more than before
options.rationale: The emphasis shifts from personal output to enabling the team.

options.text: People management can be ignored if you are technically strong
options.rationale: Technical skill does not replace managing people.

items.explanation: Correct: a manager delivers through others, so team results become the measure of success.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO describe effective performance feedback? (Select TWO)

options.text: It is specific about the behaviour and its impact
options.rationale: Correct: specific, behaviour-and-impact feedback is actionable.

options.text: It is given close in time to the event
options.rationale: Correct: timely feedback is more useful than delayed feedback.

options.text: It is saved up for the annual review
options.rationale: Delaying feedback reduces its value and fairness.

options.text: It focuses on personality rather than behaviour
options.rationale: Feedback on fixed traits is less actionable and more defensive.

items.explanation: Correct: specific, behaviour-and-impact feedback is actionable.

items.stem: What does psychological safety on a team primarily enable?

options.text: People speak up with ideas, questions and mistakes without fear of punishment
options.rationale: Correct: psychological safety lets people raise concerns and admit errors, improving learning.

options.text: Managers avoid giving any critical feedback
options.rationale: Safety supports candour, it does not remove accountability.
Healthy disagreement is a sign of safety, not its absence.

items.explanation: Correct: psychological safety lets people raise concerns and admit errors, improving learning.
